omerta.voice_notes: Sophisticated, monochrome luxury. Em dashes OK on public-facing forms. No emojis. Anonymous tone.

sunkissed.voice_notes: Less noise. More sun. More life. Tone: Rhode meets Marcela — calm, confident, scientific but lifestyle-led. Editorial > commercial; lived > staged; specific > generic ('25% zinc oxide' beats 'powerful sun protection'). Lead with the woman + her world, not the product. No exclamation points. Avoid: revolutionary, game-changing, ultimate, miracle, must-have, beauty hack, transformative, advanced. Approved: minimal formula, mineral SPF, reef-safe, sun-soaked, post-sun, ritual, ocean-conscious, life outside. Source: ~/github/omerta-cortex/spvs/sunkissed-by-heaven/03-source-docs/brand-tokens.json.
